scenes.title: A boat from Sela Thorn
scenes.summary: Sela Thorn, a tide-reader, agrees to row the party for two silver, but never at night. She says Saltmere flooded the night the bell first rang forty years ago, with warm water. She'll be at pier four at first light.

scenes.title: The flooded Saltmere Mine
scenes.summary: Warm black water floods the tunnel, with hymn-book pages floating on it. A margin note reads 'M. Brand', and Teo recognizes his sister Mira's handwriting. Dana and Priya guess the harbor-master Maren is in the cult. Oren takes 2 damage from bad air.

scenes.title: The bell at midnight
scenes.summary: Fishermen warn of the Kelp Mother and leave. At midnight the bell rings twelve times under the water, the humming louder than before, and pale shapes stand in rows on the chapel floor. The party flees.

scenes.title: Planning at the Tarred Gull
scenes.summary: The party plans to dive to the chapel at low tide tomorrow, with Sela rowing at first light. Innkeeper Bram feeds them and says Maren lost a brother to the bay. The party takes a long rest.
